beats.event: Gregor wakes transformed into a monstrous vermin
Frets about missing his salesman train, hopes it is temporary
Office manager arrives to investigate his absence
Manager sees his insect form and flees in horror
Father drives him back into his room, injuring him
Family loses income; parents and Grete must take jobs
Grete cares for him, learns he prefers spoiled food
Grete and mother begin clearing furniture from his room
Gregor emerges to protect a cherished wall portrait
Father pelts him with apples; one lodges in his back
Family neglects him; take in lodgers to survive
Drawn out by Grete's violin, he crawls into the parlor
Lodgers see him, recoil, and threaten to leave without pay
Grete declares the family must get rid of him
Gregor retreats to his room and dies of starvation
Charwoman finds his corpse; family takes a relieved outing
